title: ZXSpace Visual Walkthrough
description: Explore ZXSpace through screenshots showcasing city defence, alien invasions, power-ups, achievements, BarkinMad Coins, and arcade gameplay.
summary: Take a visual tour of ZXSpace and discover how every wave, power-up, and city defence challenge creates an exciting retro arcade experience.

sections.heading: Take a Tour of ZXSpace
paragraphs: These screenshots showcase the core gameplay of ZXSpace, from defending your first city to surviving increasingly dangerous alien waves.
Follow your journey as you collect powerful upgrades, protect your cities, earn BarkinMad Coins, unlock achievements, and compete for high scores.

sections.heading: What You'll Discover
paragraphs: The gallery highlights the major gameplay systems that define ZXSpace, helping both new and experienced players understand how the game evolves.
Each screenshot focuses on a different part of the experience, including combat, progression, rewards, and long-term objectives.

featureShowcases.heading: Defend Your First City
featureShowcases.summary: Every game begins with a city depending on you to stop the alien invasion.
body: Your mission is to destroy every alien before they reach your cities. Accurate positioning, quick reactions, and smart defensive play are the keys to survival.
Early waves introduce the core mechanics while preparing you for increasingly difficult enemy attacks.

image.caption: Every successful defence begins with protecting your first city.

featureShowcases.heading: Master the Battlefield
featureShowcases.summary: Position your cannon carefully and make the most of every power-up.
body: As enemy formations become faster and more aggressive, mastering movement and knowing when to collect power-ups becomes increasingly important.
Success depends on balancing offence, defence, and quick decision-making during every wave.

image.alt: ZXSpace hero artwork representing advanced gameplay
image.caption: Every wave demands faster reactions and better positioning.

featureShowcases.heading: Earn Rewards and Climb the Rankings
featureShowcases.summary: Achievements, BarkinMad Coins, and leaderboards reward every successful defence.
body: Every completed wave contributes towards achievements, Game Center leaderboards, and BarkinMad Coins that can be used across the ZX Series.
Improving your score and surviving longer will steadily unlock more milestones and increase your position on the global rankings.

image.caption: Every completed wave brings you closer to your next achievement.
